name: Digital Storytelling Summer Camp
org: University of Maryland, Philip Merrill College of Journalism
what_you_do: One week of hands-on media work. You do photo stories, interviews and podcasts. You also make short films and social media stories. The week ends with a show of your work.
who_can_apply: High school students entering grades 9 to 12.
pay_detail: $125 registration fee, includes a light breakfast and lunch. Scholarships available (no details given).
duration: One week, 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily (Aug 3 to 7 in 2026)
deadline_text: 2026 camp was Aug 3 to 7, 2026. No registration deadline listed. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Register online through the link on the camp page (the 2026 link was go.umd.edu/whatsyourstory2026). Questions: whatsyourstorycamp@umd.edu.
